sectionTitle: Naturalistic Explanatory Reach: Design, Mind, and Time

lockedMove.speaker: William Lane Craig
lockedMove.excerpt: Universe I think you've raised a really good question that presses very hard on the materialist namely if we are just matter in motion just electrochemical machines then everything we think is determined by our stimuli and our genetic makeup and in that case why think that your views are true because they're just determined they're like a tree growing a branch or a tooth having a toothache and there's no reason to think anything that you believe is true indeed there's no reason to think that materialism is true so that it becomes a self-defeating view similarly on materialism everything that we believe our cognitive faculties are selected by
lockedMove.proposition: If beliefs are determined by matter and selected merely for survival, materialism undercuts warrant for its own truth.
